blocks.text: Building management is changing the lobby readers this week, and the two of you are in well before the front desk is staffed, so this lands on you harder than on the rest of us. From Wednesday the side entrance stays locked until eight and the cards we hold now will not open it. The replacements are at the desk in the lobby, and they want the old cards handed back when you collect.
The building is shut Thursday and Friday for the holiday. If either of you means to come in over the long weekend, tell me today and I will have the access added before we close tomorrow.
